Q4.title: Formula and reason registry identity of a V2-profile replay
Q4.facts: Both identities are today the payload hash of the whole registry_versions capture (D-MD-B10-A002-005, D-MD-B18-A002-006), a payload that contains the whole executable build. They cannot be derived from frozen registry content and move with any source edit (F-MD-B18-A002-028).

options.A: Split for V2-profile replay only. reason_registry_hash = the capture payload's own semantic reason_registry_hash (SHA-256 of the canonical reason entries). formula_registry_hash = SHA-256 of the canonical document {registry_contract, semantic_versions, indicator_set_version, coverage_contract_version, eligibility_contract_version, config_registry_revision, config_resolver_version, serialization_version, read_model_version} from the same capture. The implementation file hashes and the build stay only in executable_build_identity. V1 keeps the whole-payload value. Both still bind the same captured registry content, so the D-MD-B10-A002-005 rule is respected.
options.B: Keep the approved whole-payload identity for both, and make the golden release-bound: the oracle re-derives the payload including the build, and every approval is valid only for one frozen build, so any application or vendor edit needs a new candidate, review and approval.

Q4.recommendation: A. B cannot give an independently reviewable literal that survives the next edit, and the two identities remain indistinguishable under it.
Q4.b10_assessment: A touches the replay verifier (and, only if a Reader projection is added, the registry capture projection). Expected B10_IMPLEMENTATION_BUT_NO_PROOF_INVALIDATION when the capture content and the manifest inputs are unchanged; to be proven by the affected B10 revalidation when implemented. Not assessed as invalidating; not implemented.

Q5.title: Executable build identity in an independent golden
Q5.facts: executable_build_identity is sha256 of the whole app/config/bootstrap/vendor tree plus composer files (today sha256:608008e96f0adf4022fbed84d4c325afed61499be79b2f12963e327c6d345320). No mechanism freezes a governed build apart from the executing build, and the review forbids asserting whatever build executes.

options.A: A closed target-bound kind "executable_build": the package asserts the mechanism, not a literal (schema php_source_build_v1, sha256: plus 64 hex, retained archive present and its hash verified, build equals the build recorded in the evidence record of the run) and carries a mandatory discriminating build-mismatch control. This lifts the instruction that none of the eleven may be a target marker for this one input.
options.B: A frozen release build: the owner designates a release build, the package asserts that literal, and the admitted proof runs only on that build; any later edit makes the approval stale and requires a new candidate version.

Q5.recommendation: A. The Replay contract (Replay_Verification_Contract_LOCKED.md:62) preserves build identity as evidence of the executing build; it is not a semantic expectation of the data. B makes every unrelated commit a re-approval.
Q5.b10_assessment: A is a verifier-only closed-list extension (NOT_B10_SEMANTIC). B adds a governed build-freeze mechanism around ProducerRegistrySnapshot and is B10_PROOF_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED if the captured registry content changes.

Q6.title: Source timestamp of a series-only provider payload (F-MD-B18-A002-027)
Q6.facts: The only provider timestamp is the chart-series bar instant (2026-03-23 09:00:00 Asia/Jakarta). The adapter drops it after deriving trade_date; the normalized row stores the acquisition clock as source_timestamp; the bar and envelope have NULL.

options.A: The per-bar provider instant is the source timestamp of the normalized row and the bar, converted to the platform timezone (Y-m-d H:i:s). The acquisition clock stays only in acquired_at/captured_at. The envelope stays NULL because the payload has no response-level observation time (to be stated in the contract note).
options.B: The series instant is data time, already bound through payload_hash, so the bar keeps a NULL source_timestamp; only the mislabelling is removed (the normalized row's source_timestamp becomes NULL instead of the acquisition clock).

Q6.recommendation: A. It gives the consumer-visible source timestamp a provider fact instead of an empty column, and it removes the mislabel.
Q6.b10_assessment: Either option changes what acquisition and import write and what the V2 bars artifact or the producer source-observation capture contains: B10_PROOF_REVALIDATION_REQUIRED until shown otherwise. B10 proofs that build rows directly are expected unaffected; this must be proven. MD-S053-R0068 (MD-B07) is not reassessed here.

Q7.title: V2 event_factor_hash membership (F-MD-B10-A002-004 residual)
Q7.facts: The V2 composite includes the whole ancillary group hash. The ancillary captures carry ticker_ids selections, bars keyed by ticker id and full bar copies with listing_id, ticker_id, run_id, publication_id and source_observation_id, so event_factor_hash differs between two allocation layouts of identical semantic content (07c7ba2e… against 0584fe8c…). The only contamination decision content is the contamination, price_scale_breaks and event_risk_contexts members of the indicator-materialized-dependencies capture, empty in the frozen world.

options.A: For V2 replace the ancillary group member by a contamination-decision projection {contamination, price_scale_breaks, event_risk_contexts} of that capture, re-keyed by retained listing root, failing closed if any local *_id remains in a non-empty entry. The dormancy, eligibility-input and benchmark/sector copies are excluded (operational copies of data already bound by the artifact hashes). The frozen empty world projects to three empty lists; the oracle defines the projection preimage and the literal.
options.B: Keep the whole ancillary group. The identity then cannot be allocation-independent and cannot be asserted, which leaves IR-1 unsatisfied for event_factor_hash.

Q7.recommendation: A, V2 only, V1 unchanged, consistent with D-MD-B18-A002-013 Q3. The owner should also say whether sector and benchmark contexts belong in this identity (recommended: no, they are not event or factor facts).
Q7.b10_assessment: Replay verifier plus a V2 capture projection reader; the V1 capture and the sealed manifest are untouched. Expected B10_IMPLEMENTATION_BUT_NO_PROOF_INVALIDATION; to be proven by the affected B10 revalidation when implemented.
